source_evidence: Do not cancel your existing policy until your new policy is in effect to ensure that there is no gap in your insurance coverage.
answer: When exchanging a variable life insurance policy, keep your current policy in force until the replacement policy is active. Canceling too soon could leave a gap in insurance coverage. Before exchanging, compare the policies’ costs and features, consider surrender charges and tax consequences, and ask for an illustration comparing the old and new policies.
